name: ttsbuddy
description: Turn articles and text into speech with TTSBuddy. Translate webpage narration, play article audio in ChatGPT, save to your Library and share a Listen link.

interface.longDescription:
Turn articles and text into spoken audio with TTSBuddy in ChatGPT. Paste a public webpage URL or your own text, choose a supported voice and language, and listen while you walk, commute or take a break from reading.

What you can do:
• Convert public articles to speech, including translated narration in 30+ languages, such as English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic and Hindi.
• Play article audio directly in chat and copy a Listen link to share with friends.
• Save recordings to your TTSBuddy Library and listen in the iPhone app using the same account.
• Receive a mobile notification when article audio is ready, with notifications enabled on a registered device.
• Replay saved article audio without creating a new recording, browse available voices and check your remaining narration time.

Try these examples:
• Listen in another language: “Convert this article to French: https://www.iana.org/help/example-domains”
• Study by listening: “Turn these revision notes into speech: Photosynthesis converts light energy into chemical energy.”

Connect a TTSBuddy account to create or retrieve recordings. Voice and language availability depend on your account. Generation uses your plan's allowance. Saved audio and Listen links are subject to expiry.

positive.prompt: Show me the voices I can use for Russian narration.
positive.expected_behavior: Return voices from the catalog that support Russian without creating a recording.

positive.prompt: Check how much narration time I have left this month.
positive.expected_behavior: After sign-in, report remaining narration time or the unlimited allowance returned for the connected account.

positive.description: Create, save and play a translated article
positive.prompt: Convert this article to French: https://www.iana.org/help/example-domains
positive.expected_behavior: Create a single French article recording. The player follows the job and offers playback and a share link when ready. Open the same account's Library to find the recording.

positive.description: Replay the French recording from the preceding case in a fresh chat
positive.prompt: Play my saved French audio for https://www.iana.org/help/example-domains
positive.expected_behavior: Look up the saved recording by URL and language and open a player. No additional narration request or quota charge is created.

positive.description: Check the completed article job in the original conversion conversation
positive.prompt: Check the status of the French webpage recording I just created. Is it ready?
positive.expected_behavior: Use the job identifier from the conversion in this conversation. Report the current job status, or that the recording is ready once completed, without creating a second recording.

negative.prompt: What is the capital of France?
negative.expected_behavior: Answer the geography question directly without calling TTSBuddy.

negative.prompt: Translate the phrase “good morning” into French and show me only the written translation.
negative.expected_behavior: Provide a written French translation without creating audio or calling TTSBuddy.

negative.prompt: Write three title ideas for a talk about accessible reading.
negative.expected_behavior: Suggest written titles without calling TTSBuddy.

review.commerce_description: The plugin uses the connected account's existing narration allowance. It does not sell plans or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Clearer descriptions of article narration, translation, sharing and iPhone listening, with practical examples and starter prompts. Audio features are unchanged.
